## ✅ Ready to Start?
<!-- Checklist for new contributors before beginning work -->
- [ ] I've read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md) guide
- [ ] I've set up the development environment successfully
- [ ] I've run `cargo test` and all tests pass
- [ ] I understand the acceptance criteria
- [ ] I've commented on this issue to claim it

## 🔄 Next Steps
<!-- What to do after claiming this issue -->

1. **Claim the issue**: Comment below saying you'd like to work on this
2. **Fork the repository**: Create your own copy to work on
3. **Create a branch**: Use a descriptive name like `fix/improve-error-messages`
4. **Make your changes**: Follow the technical details and acceptance criteria
5. **Test your work**: Ensure all existing tests still pass
6. **Submit a PR**: Reference this issue in your pull request description
